description:
Why this issue exists: jmap/thread.rs handle_thread_get() fetches up to MAX_THREAD_SCAN=5000 email rows and groups them in memory by thread_id to service a Thread/get request. For mailboxes with thousands of messages this scans the entire email table on every Thread/get call. RFC 8621 §4.5 Thread/get should be O(requested_thread_ids) not O(mailbox_size).

What needs to be done: Add a (thread_id, email_id) index and query by thread_id directly: SELECT id FROM emails WHERE thread_id = ? for each requested thread ID. The current full-scan approach was likely a prototype shortcut. Remove MAX_THREAD_SCAN and the in-memory grouping once the indexed path is in place.
title: Thread/get: O(n) full scan up to MAX_THREAD_SCAN=5000 rows per request
